title: Plate Reader Settings for sfGFP Measurement
author: Junyan Qian
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.8grhtv6

steps.title: Initialize New Protocol
steps.instruction: Create a new protocol in the PerkinElmer Victor Workstation using the start wizard.

substeps.instruction: Name the protocol after the substance being measured (e.g., sfGFP).
Select a folder to save the protocol and click Next.

steps.title: Configure Plate Settings
steps.instruction: Select the plate being used for the measurement to define default well positions.

substeps.instruction: Select NUNC 384 plate.
Click Next.

steps.title: Configure sfGFP Label
steps.instruction: Select or create the label for the measurement to set lamp, filter, and counting time parameters.

substeps.instruction: Click Label (fourth icon) on the right navigation bar.
Search the Fluorometry tab for an existing sfGFP label; if found, select it and proceed to the next step.
If no label exists, add a new label in the Fluorometry tab and name it sfGFP.
Set CW-Lamp Energy to 17000.
Set CW-Lamp Control to Stabilized Energy.
Set CW-Lamp Filter (Excitation filter) to F485.
Set Emission Filter to F535.
Set Emission Aperture to Normal (4mm in diameter).
Set Counter position to Bottom.
Set Counting time to 0.2 s.
Click OK, select the sfGFP label, and click Next.

steps.title: Select Measurement Wells
steps.instruction: Specify the wells to be measured.

substeps.instruction: Select the target wells.
Click Next.
Click Finish to finalize the measurement setup (unless adding further descriptions).

steps.title: Add Shaking Procedure
steps.instruction: Integrate a shaking step into the protocol using the PerkinElmer 2030 Manager interface.

substeps.instruction: Select Protocol editor (third icon on the second tab row).
Click the Measurement tab.
Click Shake from the events column on the right.
Set Shaking duration to 1.0s.
Set Shaking speed to Normal.
Set Shaking diameter to 0.10mm.
Set Shaking type to Linear.
Set Repeated operation to No.
Click OK.
Select Shake and use the up-pointing arrow to move it to the top of the sfGFP label to ensure shaking occurs before measurement.

steps.title: Set Plate Temperature
steps.instruction: Configure the plate reader temperature for PURE expression.

substeps.instruction: In the PerkinElmer 2030 Manager interface, select the Temperature tab.
Turn on the Plate heating option.
Set the target temperature to 37 °C.
Click Apply.

steps.title: Execute Measurement
steps.instruction: Start the measurement once the hardware has reached the target temperature.

substeps.instruction: Wait until the plate reader reaches 37 °C.
Click the Start icon to begin the measurement.
